verdict.rationale: The `greptile review` CLI reviews the feature-branch diff in about 60 seconds, and coding agents can run it on their own code, so developers can get a review locally before opening a PR. The Greptile MCP server connects to Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code and Codex, but it mainly fetches comments on PRs that already exist rather than reviewing unpushed code inside the editor. Missing for 10: a native IDE extension with inline pre-push review in the editor, explicit confirmation that the CLI review matches the PR review, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of local or IDE review.
